title: Design System: 片刻剪趣

scope.world: Marketing surfaces (homepage, pricing, 404) under .mk, plus the auth side panel: a bright, product-forward software site.
scope.outOfScope: App surfaces (editor, dashboard, account, admin, auth) keep their own Operate grammar (Plus Jakarta Sans / Noto Sans TC, rounded-xl, --shadow-card / --shadow-pop, brand red #d42c22). The shared mark is the logo (ink square, white play, red dot).
scope.decided: Owner replaced the magazine world with a bright software-site direction inspired by a commercial editor site (2026-10-27): all light, brand red as the only action colour.

components.name: mkButton
components.description: Pill buttons: red (primary), outline, white (on the red band).

components.name: PlanCards
components.description: Two rounded plan cards; featured has a red border and pill badge.

components.name: Hero / AiTabs
components.description: Editor screenshot in a browser frame with chips; five AI tabs with product-built demos.

narrative: Creative North Star "Studio Bright": a bright, product-forward software site. White and light-grey bands, brand red as the only action colour, sun-yellow highlighter, Noto Sans TC 900 headings, pill buttons, rounded panels, one soft shadow.
